items.reason: Niacinamide is a gentle active that suits the oilier feel of your skin and is easy to start with.
A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine simple and leaves your skin comfortable.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a moisture level in the middle of the range and cushions the skin while you add actives.
Daily mineral SPF 50 protects your skin from sun exposure and should go with any retinol.
A low-strength retinol is a gentle second active for a smoother-looking, more even appearance.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, niacinamide, moisturizer, then sunscreen. At night: cleanse, retinol 2 nights a week, then moisturizer, adding a night only if your skin stays comfortable.
